# Messaging Menu - A home for your notifications
A place where your notifications can collect. Its a condensed location for all of them while allowing you to ignore them if you want. Adheres to the Atayana Indicator library spec.

## Features
 - Notifications center
 - Aids user experience while using the Atayana Indicators stack
